Noida Man Hit by Car While Crossing Road with Birthday Cake

A man in Noida was struck by a speeding car while crossing the road on September 5, carrying a birthday cake. The incident was captured on CCTV footage, showing the man being thrown into the air by the impact. The car involved in the hit-and-run did not stop. One report also stated that a police officer allegedly used his foot to nudge the man lying in the street before driving off, leaving him to be hit by another car.
